The '''Yularen estate''' was a residence maintained by the [[Yularen family]] in the [[Sirpar Hills]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. During his youth, [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] spent [[Time/Legends|time]] at the estate with his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Thull Yularen]].
